svg.text: The 791 least confident of 15,813 windows (5.0% review budget), outlined. No labels were used.
Which windows to check first. (a) The map's 15,813 windows on its 128 x 128 window grid, shaded by confidence
rank from the map's own scores (dark: least confident; tied scores share a shade); the 791 least confident, a
5.0% review budget, are outlined. No labels were used: the review set says where to look first, not how wrong
the map is. Windows are drawn by row and column, row 0 at the top; no coordinates are drawn.
